t.zh: 这句话只有 →，看着古怪，真值表上每一行却都真。
t.en: This sentence has nothing but →. It looks strange, yet it is true on every row.

after.zh: 这是皮尔士律。在只有 → 的语言里，加上它就得到经典逻辑。
after.en: This is Peirce’s law. Added to a language of → alone, it gives classical logic.

hint.en: Rain or no rain: take both sides.

hint.zh: 不下雨的那一边，要设法得到「下雨 → 地湿」。
hint.en: On the side where it does not rain, find a way to get “it rains → the ground is wet”.
